name: Bobcorn
description: Agent-readable entrypoint for Bobcorn, an open-source desktop icon manager and icon font generator.

authentication.notes: Public metadata endpoints are read-only and unauthenticated.

skills.name: Find Bobcorn documentation
skills.description: Locate Bobcorn homepage, wiki, developer portal, OpenAPI spec, auth docs, webhook docs, and agent discovery files.
examples: Where is the Bobcorn OpenAPI spec?
Does Bobcorn require authentication for public metadata?

skills.name: Inspect Bobcorn release metadata
skills.description: Read the current Bobcorn release version, download URLs, and changelog entries from static metadata endpoints.
examples: What is the latest Bobcorn version?
Where can I download Bobcorn for Windows?

skills.name: Guide local Bobcorn automation
skills.description: Point coding agents to the local CLI, core operation rules, and repository AGENTS.md instructions.
examples: How should an agent automate a Bobcorn project file?
What repository instructions should I read before editing Bobcorn?
